title: AdvancedLayouts 'content' width option for `st.container`
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests.
- [x] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue.

### Summary

The FlexLayouts preview #10895 allowed to set container `width='content'`. However the latest release 1.48.0 (with AdvancedLayouts) only allows to set `content` for `height`, and not for `width`. It would be extremely useful to have this option available for both directions, just like in the preview.
